title: HollyShorts Comedy 2026
deck: Ten years of comedy: prestige, but silly.
lede: For its 10th anniversary the comedy festival got a poster built like a set: a clapperboard, a director's chair, a rubber duck and banana peels on hot pink. Then it started to move.
challenge: HollyShorts Comedy turned 10 in 2026, with the festival from May 1 to 3 at LOOK Dine-In Cinemas in Glendale, California. The brief came down to two words: prestige, but silly.
work: The anniversary poster builds one isometric set of comedy props on hot pink, from a “Take 10” clapperboard and a director's chair to a rubber duck, popcorn and banana peels. Its inflated, candy-like type carries through the badges, the official selections and the award show, and the poster was animated for the screen.

The type was tested on paper first. Printed studies of the schedules and badges, and a sheet of merchandise concepts, sat on the desk before the finals. A 10th anniversary mark was made in several colorways.

The campaign ran from the date announcement to the official selections, 91 films, and the screening schedules, which also played on the cinema's displays. It took in the IMGN film fund competition, the opening night invitation, the award show and the winner laurels. The tees carry their own jokes: “Take 10,” “I'm With Stupid” and “This Is My Red Carpet Outfit.”
system: One isometric scene of props on hot pink.
